tools.name: get_coauthors
tools.description: Get all co-authors for a given author. Args: name: Author's first name surname: Author's last name institution: Optional institution affiliation field: Optional research field Returns: Dictionary containing co-authors list with their information

tools.name: get_author_keywords
tools.description: Get research keywords/areas for a given author from Google Scholar. Args: name: Author's first name surname: Author's last name institution: Optional institution affiliation Returns: Dictionary containing keywords extracted from Google Scholar
